svg.title: Tesseract verification oracle chain
svg.desc: References (Spike, libtsr_ref with the VU and AT references, the numpy spec models, the ggml CPU backend) check the simulator, its RV32 interpreter and the ggml-tesseract backend on TSR_DEVICE=sim through numcheck, klcheck and test-backend-ops. The firmware kernels, built for RISC-V and for the host, are checked against C++ references and the ggml CPU backend in firmware tests under 8 schedules with the race detector; tsr-selftest compares a device with the in-process simulator. tsr-trace-gen and TSR_TRACE dumps make trace sets whose results come from the simulator; they replay on the simulator kinds and through the replay kernel. The RTL replay, the Ibex lockstep, the RTL mutation campaigns and the replay on the card are planned.
